title: 猫咪与毛线球
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional children's coloring-book illustration. Square 1024x1024. Main subject: a very cute playful kitten gently balancing one paw on a large ball of yarn, with an amusing tilted head and a curved lively tail. This is for a tablet coloring game ages 5–12 and MUST be SIMPLE and FUN TO COLOR, not intricate. Expert illustrator's confident warm expressive organic drawing, flowing curves and charming asymmetry; no geometric clip-art assembly. Main character fills about 70% of the square. ONLY 10–14 large enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE image, never more than 20. Simplify aggressively. Plan the shapes: kitten's head, body, two large inner ears, two broad paws, one belly patch, tail, a yarn ball divided into only THREE broad curved bands, one small sun, and a single gently curved ground shape. Keep all these shapes broad and easy to touch, no tiny enclosed islands. Facial expression uses simple solid black oval eyes without white highlights, and a single open smile curve; whiskers are just two short open strokes on each side. Smooth silhouette, NO fur tufts, NO stripes, NO spots, NO claw/toe divisions. Yarn has ONLY TWO interior curved dividing lines, no dense crosshatching. Background almost empty WHITE, no flowers, no leaves, no fence, no clouds, no grass blades, no floating confetti or extra objects. The kitten's pose and the oversized rolling yarn ball provide the playfulness. Crisp bold black outlines, approximately 6px outer and 4px interior at 1024 resolution, smooth closed contours; no sketch lines, no gray shading, no color, no gradients, no paper texture. The whole drawing and all appendages comfortably inside a 6% white margin, never cropped. No border, no lettering, no watermark. Refined professional SIMPLE children's picture-book line art with generous blank coloring areas, instantly readable and lovable.
visualReview: Approved original and numbered mask: 14 broad regions; tiny nose highlight is fixed ink detail.
